scope: Independent static visual review only; no art edits, approval, publication or runtime verification.

reviews.readme_context: README discloses stylized non-surveyed wetland, procedural rather than scanned materials, delicate papyrus, ambiguous silt/fibre finish, family hardware and sampled checks.

observations.observation: Pale fibre-textured chest, turquoise inset with three green planted banks, slender umbrella-like plants, brass fittings and rough stone-like feet. Complete silhouette; no obvious large missing surfaces.
Full chest and plants framed; turquoise wetland and repeated woven/wood-like body pattern readable. Open lid and Reset view controls visible.
Full raised lid and projecting latch framed; empty lined cavity and green rim visible. Hinge region has a visually suspended appearance, but contact is not resolved and detachment is not established.
Entire chest and plants visible; water/islets read clearly, but papyrus crowns become fine pixel-thin marks. Title wraps without clipping.
Open chest and latch fully contained; hollow interior readable. No definite disconnected component, missing wall or UI overlap.

limitations: Papyrus is delicate at mobile size; scene can read as generic tropical islets rather than a specific Sudd wetland.
Water is a flat turquoise inset rather than flowing channels; ochre surface reads woven/bamboo/wood-like rather than literal sediment.
Repetitive surface pattern and fine-geometry aliasing remain; green seam and rough feet are conspicuous.

observations.observation: Blue-gray masonry/slate chest with pale-green lid fields and intersecting pale raised walls, brass fittings, green reveal and rough stone feet. Complete composition; no major visible breakage.
Slate courses, meadow panels and raised field boundaries readable with full silhouette. Green seam conspicuous; no clipped asset or UI.
Raised slate-textured underside, tab and feet framed. Empty blue-gray cavity readable; floor partly occluded. No established disconnected hinge.
Whole chest, walled green fields and hardware visible; wall relief looks chunky/jagged at this scale. Two-line heading and controls fit.
Entire open box and upper tab contained; green rim and cavity readable. Small hardware contacts unresolved, not proven defective.

limitations: Body reads regular tiled masonry rather than fractured natural slate; smooth shallow meadow relief loses depth on mobile.
Upright coping can resemble a stone palisade; selective Welsh/Yorkshire inspiration is not comprehensive UK representation.
Green seam is an invented reveal; chunky walls/feet and simplified brass remain stylized.
